triggers.tooltip: Whenever you parry or dodge an attack, your attack speed is increased by $806194s1%, and your parry chance by $806194s2% for $806194d, stacking $806194u times.
triggers.trigger_text: Whenever you parry or dodge an attack
triggers.observe_note: spell_proc row of 806195 (rev_20260908_07_witch_hunter_completion.sql:38): ProcFlags 139944, HitMask 48 (PROC_HIT_DODGE 16 | PROC_HIT_PARRY 32), Chance 100; the handler's Check case 806195 (AscensionWitchHunterEvents.cpp:198-199) passes an incoming avoided attack and HandleProc casts Dark Intuition 806194 on the caster (self(806194), :413-414). An aggressive striker (creature 36) swings at the caster, who wears Evasion 26669 (+50% dodge) refreshed before every 2000 ms attempt as a precondition fixture (the trigger action avoided, ADR 0709); every dodged (victim_state 2) or parried (victim_state 3) swing is a trial, and the spell_cast_count of 806194 must match it. The attempt interval only paces the reads; the trials are counted, not assumed (trial_attempts_factor 2.5 for misses and hits).
triggers.trial_attempts_reason: An attempt is one striker swing interval; only the dodged or parried swings are trials (Evasion gives +50% dodge, the rest hit or miss), so 2.5 times the swings are scheduled to reach the trigger trials.

behaviours.name: Dark Riposte (parried swing restore)

behaviours.observe_source: $504475s1 = 5 (504475 EffectBasePoints[0] 4 + EffectDieSides[0] 1). 503659's aura script (AscensionWitchHunterEvents.cpp:158, a taken proc with PROC_HIT_PARRY; :313-319 with PreventDefaultAction at :224, so 504475 itself is never cast) heals through 574335 for (maximum - current health) / 20 and energizes Rage under 503659 for (maximum - current Rage) / 20; those two ids are taken from the code only to know which events to count, the expected amounts come from $504475s1 and the missing values read at each cycle's start. 574335 cannot crit (AttributesEx2 SPELL_ATTR2_CANT_CRIT in the DBC, also forced at AscensionWitchHunterCompletion.cpp:389) and its hit heal is set to its base points by spell_ascension_witch_hunter_copy (AscensionWitchHunterCompletion.cpp:543-549) after EffectHeal's done and taken modifiers (code reading), so no healing modifier scales it. Only a parried melee auto attack triggers it (a parried spell carries no damage, c14-tool2 H4), so one aggressive attacker, creature 36 (BaseAttackTime 2000 in creature_template), rooted in front by Self Root Forever (No Visual) 42716, swings at the caster; each 1000 ms cycle is shorter than its swing, so a cycle holds at most one swing, taken from the state set and read at the cycle's start. Parry 100% and dodge 0% (set_combat_avoidance) are a named precondition fixture of both arms. In each treatment cycle the 574335 heal and 503659 energize events must number its parried swings and total 5% of the missing health and Rage read at its start, truncated (exact integers, so 4.5% and 5.5% fail); a cycle whose health or Rage at its end is not its start plus its events took a foreign change and is left out (run 20261116-113712: about 18 health and 1 to 2 Rage lost every 6 to 9 s without a swing, source not identified), a missed swing is not judged, two swings in a cycle or fewer than 10 judged parried swings leave it unmeasured. Control: 503659 unlearned, no event and no gain.

behaviours.name: Lightbringer (kept by Purifier's Edge)
behaviours.quote: This effect has a 25% chance to not be consumed by Purifier's Edge.
behaviours.observe_source: spell_ascension_witch_hunter_ability (AscensionWitchHunterAbilities.cpp): Before (BeforeCast, :235) notes whether the caster holds Lightbringer 680539; After (AfterCast, :418-422) for a spell of SpellFamilyFlags[1] 134217728 (Purifier's Edge) removes 680539 unless roll_chance_i(25). The roll is in AfterCast, so a completed cast rolls whether it hits or is avoided; a failed cast (cast_failure not 0) is no trial. 680539 (Effect[0] aura 108 SPELLMOD_COST -100% on the Purifier's Edge mask, no charges, no interrupt flags, infinite duration) is set by harness set_aura before every cast: a precondition fixture, the subject is the consumption roll. Purifier's Edge 802434 (BaseLevel 60, the level 60 rank; SPELL_ATTR3_REQUIRES_OFF_HAND_WEAPON, which AscensionWitchHunterCompletion.cpp:157-158 clears for Dusk Blade only, so Worn Shortsword 25 (item_template: one-hand sword, InventoryType 13, RequiredLevel 1) is equipped in the off hand; every Witch Hunter learns Dual Wield 674 at login, AscensionLiveBaselineData.h:70; 6000 ms cooldown reset before each cast, 1500 ms global cooldown, free under 680539). Control: Fiery Judgement 803369 (SpellFamilyFlags[2] 131072, outside the Purifier's Edge mask; 11% mana, The End Is Near 680486 -100% power cost set before each control cast) keeps 680539 every time. 680538 is learned in both arms (real learn); Dusk Blade is never cast, so no new 680539 proc. G-20 step 1, pilot (one part, run 20261115-072903): 88 of 320 casts kept 680539, 27.5% (Wilson 99% interval 21.6% to 34.3%), 10 of 10 control casts kept it: effect present, interval stated. Pooled proof: 59 parts of 320 (18880 casts; the band needs 12443). At a true 25% the 99% half-width is about 0.81 points, so a conformant server leaves the 23-27% band with probability about 1.6e-4 per run (|deviation| > 1.19 points, z 3.77).

behaviours.observe_source: 805751 DurationIndex 28 ($d = 5000 ms), a channel on the caster (Effect[0] aura 4, Effect[1] aura 31, Effect[2] aura 23 every 500 ms triggering 805752). It drains ManaPerSecond 100 (10 Rage) each second and its aura is removed when the Rage is below that (SpellAuras.cpp:761-791), so the Rage is set to 1000 before the cast (a precondition fixture, mentor D-112). One real cast: the aura is on the caster about 4770 ms after the cast and gone about 5170 ms after it, so the end lies inside the G-19 band (4750..5250 ms, 5% of 5000) on both sides in game time. Control (before): no cast, absent. The crossbow 15809 worn by the spell's weapon set arms the cast (EquippedItemClass 2).

behaviours.name: Twilight Frenzy (shot damage, +1000 ranged attack power)
behaviours.quote: firing shots at nearby enemies for $805753s2% Ranged Weapon Damage plus ${$cond($gt($sps, $sph), $805753m1+$805753ppl1+$sps*.2+$RAP*.1, $805753m1+$805753ppl1+$sph*.2+$RAP*.1)} as Twilight Damage.
behaviours.expected_source: Twilight Frenzy 805751 fires 805753 at nearby enemies every 500 ms through 805752 (Effect[2] aura 23, EffectAmplitude 500); 805753 is cast directly at the dummy 10 yd away (SpellRange 6, 0 to 100 yd, Flags 0), the shot the clause describes. Spell.dbc 805753: Effect[1] 31 WEAPON_PERCENT_DAMAGE 49 + 1 = 50% ($805753s2); Effect[0] 2 SCHOOL_DAMAGE 14 + 1 = 15 ($805753m1) with EffectRealPointsPerLevel 1.0 from SpellLevel 29: at level 60 int32(31 x 1.0) = 31, so 46; SchoolMask 34 (Holy and Shadow, Twilight). The Witch Hunter coefficient row {805753, effect 0, rap 0.1, sp 0.2, school 34} (AscensionWitchHunterCoefficients.h:119) adds 0.1 x RAP + 0.2 x max(Holy, Shadow spell power) to Effect[0] (AscensionWitchHunterCompletion.cpp:611-623; $sps and $sph are the Shadow and Holy spell power tokens, so the server's max matches the tooltip's $cond) and zeroes its stock BonusMultiplier (:421-423); the record's effect_value 805753e0 read 69 at RAP 237 (46 + 23.7). Weapon part: 50% of the Boltslinger crossbow 15809 (49-50, 2800 ms) with RAP / 14 x 2.8 = 0.2 x RAP: B = 0.5 x (49.5 + 0.2 x RAP) + 46 + int(0.1 x RAP) + 0.2 x SP; reference RAP 237, SP 0: 48.45 + 69 = 117.45. Non-critical hits only; partial resists and percent modifiers act alike in both arms, so the ratio does not depend on them. Ranged attack power contrast (D-57): QA Test +1000 Melee and Ranged AP 10031 in the treatment arm only (a real aura, as the Heartseeking Bolt rap entry), RAP 1237: B = 0.5 x (49.5 + 247.4) + 46 + 123 = 317.45, ratio 317.45 / 117.45 = 2.7029 (+170.3%, band 8.5 points). Readings that must alert: no RAP term 2.0588, a 100% weapon part 2.808, a 0.2 RAP term 3.121, no weapon part 2.449. Sizing from the measured spread (Witch Hunter ADR 0025 first pair 20261117-152309 / -152444, 60 trials per arm: 99% half-widths 10.8 to 12.0 points, a standard error of about 4.7 points, mostly from the 10% partial-resist steps): 160 trials x 5 parts = 800 per arm, standard error about 1.3 points, 99% half-width about 3.3 under the 4.26 limit. False alert (true +170.3%, estimate outside +-8.51) about 3e-11 per run. False pass: no RAP term (2.0588), a 0.2 RAP term (3.121) and no weapon part (2.449) are at least 16.9 points outside the band (below 1e-30 per pair); a 100% weapon part (+180.8%) lies 2.0 points beyond the band edge, so this entry alone passes it with about 6% per run, 0.34% per pair, and that defect is held by the shot_sp entry (it reads 2.2056 there, 41 points outside its band, false pass below 1e-30 per pair). The main-hand weapon source reads 2.756 here, inside the band: this entry cannot tell the weapon source, shot_sp does.
behaviours.observe_source: Joint reading (mentor D-480, review-g): 379.0 counts on shot_sp AND shot_rap together; shot_rap is never read alone for this part. A false pass must get through both: for a 100% weapon part shot_rap alone passes at about 0.34% per pair, shot_sp alerts it (2.2056), so the joint false-pass residual per pair is below 1e-30, under D-343.

behaviours.name: Twilight Frenzy (the channel continues while the caster moves)
behaviours.quote: Can dodge and parry and move while active.
behaviours.observe_source: 805751 is a channel on the caster (AttributesEx SPELL_ATTR1_IS_CHANNELED, DurationIndex 28 = 5000 ms) with ChannelInterruptFlags 0 and InterruptFlags 0 in Spell.dbc, so no movement interrupt applies to it. The caster is moved by the harness relocate step (the native position update of a client movement packet: Unit::UpdatePosition, Unit.cpp:17605-17625, then RemoveAurasWithInterruptFlags, Unit.cpp:6238-6283, which interrupts a channel whose ChannelInterruptFlags carry AURA_INTERRUPT_FLAG_MOVE), 1.5 yd along y and back, every 500 ms. The metric reads the remaining time of the caster's own channeled spell (cast_remaining_ms, 0 when it is not channeling). The Rage is set to 1000 before the cast (a precondition fixture, mentor D-112). Six moves at 500, 1000 ... 3000 ms, the reading 1000 ms after the last one (about 4000 ms after the cast): the channel must still run, remaining at least 500 ms of the 5000 ms (about 1000 expected). Before (control): no cast, 0. Control arms: Witchbane 574320 moved the same way (moving_channel_witchbane_moved, expected 0) and not moved (moving_channel_witchbane_still).

behaviours.name: Witchbane (control: a channel with the movement interrupt is interrupted by the same moves)
behaviours.quote: Can dodge and parry and move while active.
behaviours.observe_source: Control arm of Twilight Frenzy moving_channel. The dummy stands 17.5 yd away (dummy_distance): at the default distance the cast was refused with SPELL_FAILED_TOO_CLOSE (128, pair 20261116-211051, the still arm), so the first moved arm read 0 without any channel. Witchbane 574320 is a channel (AttributesEx SPELL_ATTR1_IS_CHANNELED, DurationIndex 27 = 3000 ms, 40 Rage, RangeIndex 114 = 35 yd) whose Spell.dbc ChannelInterruptFlags is 0, but the Witch Hunter contract adds InterruptFlags SPELL_INTERRUPT_FLAG_MOVEMENT and ChannelInterruptFlags AURA_INTERRUPT_FLAG_MOVE to the spells of family 21 flag word 1 bit 4194304 (AscensionWitchHunterCompletion.cpp:182-185; 574320 has SpellFamilyFlags[1] 4194304). The caster is moved by the harness relocate step (the native position update of a client movement packet: Unit::UpdatePosition, Unit.cpp:17605-17625, then RemoveAurasWithInterruptFlags, Unit.cpp:6238-6283, which interrupts a channel whose ChannelInterruptFlags carry AURA_INTERRUPT_FLAG_MOVE), 1.5 yd along y and back, every 500 ms. The metric reads the remaining time of the caster's own channeled spell (cast_remaining_ms, 0 when it is not channeling). The Rage is set to 1000 before the cast (a precondition fixture, mentor D-112). Two moves at 500 and 1000 ms, the reading 1000 ms after the last one (about 2000 ms after the cast): the channel must be gone, remaining 0. No DBC channel of the class carries the movement interrupt in Spell.dbc (the scan of SpellFamilyName 21 channels lists Witchbane, Shadow Barrage(Test), Twilight Frenzy and Sixfold Shot, all with ChannelInterruptFlags 0), so the control carries it through the server rule.

behaviours.name: Witchbane (control: the same cast without moves keeps channeling)
behaviours.quote: Can dodge and parry and move while active.
behaviours.observe_source: Control of the Witchbane moved arm: the same cast (dummy at 17.5 yd, dummy_distance; at the default distance the cast was refused with SPELL_FAILED_TOO_CLOSE 128 in pair 20261116-211051) and the same reading time (about 2000 ms after the cast, a 2000 ms wait) without the moves. Witchbane lasts 3000 ms (DurationIndex 27), so the channel must still run with about 1000 ms remaining, at least 500. It shows that the moved arm reads 0 because of the moves and not because the cast failed or ended early. The metric reads the remaining time of the caster's own channeled spell (cast_remaining_ms, 0 when it is not channeling). The Rage is set to 1000 before the cast (a precondition fixture, mentor D-112).

behaviours.name: Fiery Judgement (Flames of Sin extension, present at 4750 ms)
behaviours.quote: or increases the duration by $/1000;803503s2 sec
behaviours.observe_source: 803503 Effect[1] 177 adds 3000 ms ($/1000;803503s2) to the remaining Flames of Sin 803422 (the grant of 3000 ms applies when none is active). Control (before): one Fiery Judgement 803369 at the dummy, 803422 read on the caster 4750 ms later: absent (0), the unextended 3000 ms grant is over. Treatment (after): a setup Fiery Judgement grants Flames, 1100 ms later the trigger Fiery Judgement is cast (category cooldown cleared after the setup cast), and 803422 is read 4750 ms after the trigger: present (1). The extended aura ends 3000 ms past the 1900 ms remaining at the trigger, 4900 ms after it, and the read sits 150 ms inside that end (5% of the 3 sec). The bracket measures grant plus extension; the split relies on GrantOrExtend granting with the same effect value it extends by (AscensionWitchHunterFlames.cpp:102-119, verified by the cycle 6 review). Whether the setup Fiery Judgement (DmgClass melee) must hit for its grant to apply was not checked; if it must, the setup roll is another unforced outcome (cycle 6 review M-6).

Beeg spellpen 823764 (partial resists) on the caster is a harness set_aura precondition fixture, not the claim's subject; the pulse's crit is forced off: 807762 is DmgClass 2 (melee) with no can't-crit attribute and the reference caster's melee crit chance is 2.2907 (300792 melee_crit_chance_refreshed before value), so the harness test aura 984954 is set on the caster in both phases with its Effect[0] aura 52 SPELL_AURA_MOD_WEAPON_CRIT_PERCENT (EquippedItemClass -1, every attack type) changed to -1000 (phase_aura_amounts), which holds the melee crit chance at 0; its Effect[1] aura 57 is the spell crit -1000 of the DBC. behaviours.name: Flourish (Flames of Sin cleaves up to 3 additional enemies on a real swing)
behaviours.quote: to cleave up to $s3 additional enemies
behaviours.radius_reason: Flourish 805365 Effect[2] is aura 107 (ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER) with EffectMiscValue 17 (SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS), EffectBasePoints 2 + 1 = 3 ($s3) and EffectSpellClassMask word 2 = 16384, on the caster; its Effect[0] triggers Flames of Sin 803422 and its Effect[1] (177, EffectBasePoints 9999 + 1) grants it for 10000 ms (GrantOrExtend, AscensionWitchHunterFlames.cpp:101-119). Flames of Sin casts 802850 (SpellFamilyFlags[2] 16384, so the mask matches) at the victim of every landed auto attack of the caster that deals damage, with 40% of that damage (EffectBasePoints[0] 39 + 1, AscensionWitchHunterFlames.cpp:145-165, a triggered cast that loads the copied damage, :186-201); the Flames contract sets 802850 ChainTarget 1 (AscensionWitchHunterFlames.cpp:262-268), so Flourish raises it to 4, and every jump keeps EffectDamageMultiplier 0.95 of a nonzero hit. 802850 is DmgClass 1 (magic): Spell::SearchChainTargets takes a jump radius of 10 yd (Spell.cpp:2210-2225). Swing route (swing_ms): Flourish is cast at the caster first, then the caster auto attacks the primary dummy 3 yd away for 2000 ms and stops; the class ratings (10000 melee hit and expertise) remove misses, dodges and parries, so the swing at the attack start lands. The counted runs (20261117-164456 / -172516) read the primary 802850 count 0 -> 2 from cast 0 to cast 1 in every result, so each window held two 802850 triggers (source not established), and the extras are judged on the union of both triggers' targets. Chain targets are unique per trigger (Spell.cpp:2242, :2291-2292), so the 2 hits on each of three extras and none on the fourth mean each trigger hit exactly 3. The additional dummies stand within 4 yd of the primary (primary_distance_reads); one dummy beyond the three stated stays in the cluster and must stay unhit (headroom), and one dummy beyond the radius must stay unhit. A cap of 4 reads 4 on the exact count and alerts; a cap of 2 reads 2 and alerts only while both triggers of a window take the same targets (chain order by distance, Spell.cpp:2273-2281, with unmoving dummies; not proven), so its false pass per pair is not established; a window without a primary hit is unmeasured, never ok (false alert 0 per pair). The direct cast of 802850 (pair 20261117-144038 / -144507) carried no copied damage (the script loads only for a triggered cast), so its jumps dealt int32(1 x 0.95) = 0 and logged nothing; this entry takes the real path.

Flames of Sin 803422 comes from its helper 803710 cast at the caster (Effect[0] 64 triggers 803422, Effect[1] 177 EffectBasePoints 2999 + 1 = 3000 ms, the helper the Dawn Blade talent 92094 casts; a precondition fixture, not the claim's subject); the attack starts after the 1600 ms wait of that cast, inside the 3000 ms. Without SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS 802850 keeps ChainTarget 1, so no additional dummy may be hit, while the primary hit shows that the swing triggered 802850.

behaviours.name: Anguish (next Darkflock duration)
behaviours.quote: and reduce the duration of your next Darkflock within $500566d by ${-$500566m1}%.
behaviours.observe_source: A real proc, no harness aura (mentor D-59, review I-2): each phase casts Dusk Blade 802258 at the dummy (its Shadow main-hand strike and the off-hand strike 803502 it casts through Effect[1] 142, both landing with the entry's two 2027 one-handers), waits 1600 ms (the 1500 ms global cooldown), then casts Darkflock 562025 on the caster and reads its remaining duration 100 ms later. Before phase (control, 504742 not learned): no Anguish proc, Darkflock DurationIndex 31 = 8000 ms. After phase (504742 learned): the Shadow hit passes Check case 504742 (AscensionWitchHunterEvents.cpp:153-154) and, on the engine's roll of the DBC ProcChance 5 (spell_proc Chance 0), HandleProc casts Anguish 500566 on the caster (self(500566), Events.cpp:306-307), whose aura script resets the Darkflock cooldown on apply (Events.cpp:458-476); 500566 Effect[1] aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER EffectMiscValue[1] 1 (SPELLMOD_DURATION) on EffectSpellClassMask word 0 bit 2, Darkflock's SpellFamilyFlags[0] 2, EffectBasePoints[1] -51 with EffectDieSides[1] 1 = -50% (${-$500566m1} = 50), so the next Darkflock lasts 8000 x (1 - 0.50) = 4000 ms. Forcing fixture (forced_roll, ADR 0588, effect claims only, mentor N-a1): SPELLMOD_CHANCE_OF_SUCCESS +1000% on 504742 for the scenario so the 5% roll lands on the first hit, removed at the end and read gone; the chance itself is the 504742 proc_rate entry. Both readings lose the 100 ms wait and the step window (at most 25 ms per step); tolerance 300 ms still separates 8000 from 4000. expire_ms 8500 lets the before phase's Darkflock end. Residual failure probability: the roll is forced to 11 x the 5% proc chance, 55% per landed Shadow hit, so each phase makes six Dusk Blade casts (twelve strikes, 1600 ms apart, 9600 ms against the 15 s of the Anguish aura 500566, which the next Darkflock consumes) and the chance of no proc is 0.45^12, about 0.007% per scenario; the darkflock, darkflock_held and darkflock_ends scenarios each roll it, about 0.021% per run and 0.041% per pair (cycle 13 resize from 3 casts, D-197 at most 0.1% per pair; cycle 6 review M-2).

behaviours.name: Gaze of the Black Knight (health at 18% breaks the effect)
behaviours.quote: Damage which reduces your health below $s2% will break the effect.
behaviours.observe_source: 802138 Spell.dbc Description "Damage which reduces your health below $s2% will break the effect." $s2 = EffectBasePoints[1] 19 + 1 = 20, read from the DBC, not from the code. The caster casts Gaze at itself; 200 ms later its health is set to 3600 (18%) of 20000 and one Demon striker (creature 418) lands one strike of 32247 (1000 Physical), absorbed whole by the Gaze shield (about 4021), so the strike leaves the shield standing and health unchanged: the two arms differ only in the health level. Why not real damage to the threshold: any damage that reaches health exhausts the shield first, and an exhausted absorb removes the whole aura (Unit.cpp CalcAbsorbResist, absorbAurEff->GetBase()->Remove), so a break by damage cannot be told from the shield running out (design 1, both arms read 0). The arms sit 10% of the stated value on each side of 20% (3600, exactly 18%, breaks; 4399, just under 22%, holds), and "below" is strict, so a threshold of 18% or lower fails the first arm (3600 is not below 18%) and one of 22% or higher fails the second (4399 is below 22%): only a threshold in (18%, 22%) passes both (review14 I-1). This label proves the 20% health threshold only; the damage that reduces health stays unmeasured. Reference search: nothing found for the break threshold.

behaviours.name: Gaze of the Black Knight (a hit that takes health below 20% breaks the effect)
behaviours.quote: Damage which reduces your health below $s2% will break the effect.
behaviours.observe_source: 802138 Spell.dbc Description "Damage which reduces your health below $s2% will break the effect." $s2 = EffectBasePoints[1] 19 + 1 = 20, read from the DBC. Design 2 for the damage cause (design 1, 8 absorbed strikes, read 0 in both arms because damage through the shield exhausts it and an exhausted absorb removes the whole aura, Unit.cpp CalcAbsorbResist). Here the damage is real and the shield is not touched: the striker (creature 418) casts Pyromancer 802173 (Spell.dbc Effect[0] 2 SCHOOL_DAMAGE Fire, single enemy target 6; the description reads "piercing all resistances and absorption effects"; AscensionPyromancerContracts.cpp:173-176 sets AscensionIgnoreAbsorbAndResistance on it and CalcAbsorbResist returns before any absorb, Unit.cpp:2662-2663) four times 100 ms apart, so every hit lands on health with the Gaze shield (about 4021) standing. The damage per hit is a fixture size, not a claimed value: a diagnostic run read 109 per hit (436 for four, health 4020 to 3584, no absorb, eight hits 872 over both phases). The 20% line of 20000 is 4000 and "below" is strict. Cross arm: health is set to 4300 (21.5%, not below the line) 200 ms after the Gaze cast and the four hits take it to about 3864 (19.3%), below the line: the aura is gone. Both arms use the same strike spell, count and Gaze: only the health left by the hits differs, so a break in one arm and not the other is the damage crossing the line, not the hits as such and not the shield running out. Reference search: nothing found for the damage cause. The first attempt with Pyromancer 680371 (cone target 24) landed no damage (health stayed 4700, no damage event) and was replaced by this single-target spell with the same absorb-piercing flag.

behaviours.name: Houndmaster (Lesser Shadow Hound one leap)
behaviours.contract_note: Six Houndmaster's Call 802273 casts per arm, 3 s apart with the cooldown reset, each summons one Lesser Shadow Hound 50224 (803886 summons it once) and calls the owned hounds to leap, so every cast opens its own called leap inside the 20 s auto-leap (AscensionWitchHunterSummons.cpp:115, :135) and the 15 s life of a hound, whatever one leap delivers (run 1 of final08 counted two strikes, run 2 one: insufficient_trials). The hound's auto attacks roll the aura's 50% (case 804192, AscensionWitchHunterEvents.cpp:424-425, StrikeShadowRage :87-91): Shadow Rage damage 567570 from the hound for the effect amount plus 0.15 x the owner's ranged attack power. Partial resists are removed on the caster as a precondition fixture (823764); crits are not removed because 984954 raises the melee crit chance (aura 52 +101) and 567570 is a melee class hit (DmgClass 2): a diagnostic run with it read 4 of 4 hits critical, and only non-critical hits are judged. The 567570 hits of entry 50224 over six calls, each about 8 s of hound life after the Shadowblast, are judged against the tooltip figure at the measured stats; the control arm makes the Call without the Shadowblast, so the hound never carries 804192 and must show no 567570 hit. The hit is read on the caster side (no caster_entry): StrikeShadowRage casts 567570 from the hound with the owner as original caster (AscensionWitchHunterEvents.cpp:87-91), so the damage log credits the owner and a filter on the hound's entry reads 0 (a diagnostic run read 5 hits without the filter, 0 with entry 50224). Residual failure probability (cycle 13 resize from 6 calls, D-197): the final12 pair read 22 and 17 usable (non-critical) hits over 6 calls, about 3.2 per call; with 10 calls the mean is about 32 against the minimum of 8, a normal margin of 4.3 sd (sd at most the root of the mean, 5.7), about 1e-5 per run and 2e-5 per pair. The 98 versus 91 reading of the amount is the owner-held Q-wh-19 and is not part of this sizing.

behaviours.name: Shadow Rage (Lesser Shadow Hound strike, +1000 ranged attack power)
behaviours.quote: Auto attacks have a $h% chance to deal an additional ${$m3*$<scalingbp>+$RAP*0.15} Shadow Damage.
behaviours.observe_source: As the hound_strike entry, with the ranged attack power term of the text (D-57): QA Test +1000 Melee and Ranged AP 10031 is set on the caster before its stats are measured (a precondition fixture; the claim is the 0.15 x ranged attack power term that StrikeShadowRage reads from the owner, AscensionWitchHunterEvents.cpp:84-92), so the model reads the higher ranged attack power: server amount 56 + int32(0.15 x 1237 = 185.55) = 241 against 91 at the reference 237, tooltip 241.83. A text that kept $AP*0.15 would read 56.28 + 0.15 x the measured melee attack power, which 10031 raises alike, so the contrast with the base entry separates a working coefficient (+150) from none (+0); the RAP and AP readings are told apart by the base entry at 237 RAP against 282 AP. Same 10 calls, minimum 8 hits and residual sizing as the base entry (about 2e-5 per pair).

behaviours.name: Coordinated Killing (Shadow Rage, ranged auto attack strike)
behaviours.quote: Ranged auto attacks deal an additional ${$m3+$RAP*0.15} Shadow Damage.
behaviours.observe_source: Each trial casts Unleash the Hounds 807933 at the dummy (Shadow Rage 680275 on the caster for 15000 ms with 705463 learned, none in the control arm) and then one Auto Shot 75 (PROC_FLAG_DONE_RANGED_AUTO_ATTACK, case 680275 of AscensionWitchHunterEvents.cpp:207-208); StrikeShadowRage casts 567570 at the target for the aura's effect 2 amount plus int32(0.15 x the caster's ranged attack power) (AscensionWitchHunterEvents.cpp:84-92). The non-critical 567570 hits are judged against the tooltip figure at the measured stats (text of owner ruling O-39: 57 + 0.15 x the ranged attack power, client reading 69 at RAP 80 and 92 at RAP 235 in the fu-text client check); $m3 rolls 57..58 when the aura is applied (Spell.dbc 680275 EffectBasePoints[2] 56, EffectDieSides[2] 2, the tooltip showing the lower roll), and value_rolls models both rolls of the value spell's die; partial resists are removed by 823764 as a precondition fixture. The control arm must show no 567570 hit. False-alert residual (mentor D-419, D-197): each usable non-critical 567570 hit is one of the two rolls of $m3 plus the same attack power term, so the mean of the 39 usable hits lies within 0.5 of the model mean (sigma 0.5); an alert needs a mean beyond 5% of it (compare.py TOLERATED_RELATIVE, 4.6 points at 92.5, 12.1 at 242.5), so the false-alert residual is 0 by bound. Only the 99% interval of the mean (+-0.206) can be left, giving 'tolerated' (conformant): 2 x P(Binomial(39, 0.5) <= 11) = 0.95% per run.

Witch Hunter ADR 0020 (amended, mentor D-358): Heartseeking Bolt captures bp0 = 504478 amount (base x stacks) + (0.3 x RAP + 0.45 x Holy SP) x stacks at its cast (BeforeCast), removes 504478 at AfterCast, and casts Collect Bounty 504687 (Spell.dbc SCHOOL_DAMAGE, SchoolMask 2, BasePoints 0, EffectBonusMultiplier 0, no spell_bonus_data) with that bp0 when the bolt hits (BeforeHit, SPELL_MISS_NONE). The End Is Near 680486 (free casts) and beeg spellpen 823764 (no partial resist, so the model is unresisted) are precondition fixtures. behaviours.name: Tonic Supply (other Tonic cooldown cut)
behaviours.quote: Using a Tonic now reduces the cooldown of all other Tonics by $/1000;s1 sec.
behaviours.observe_source: $/1000;s1 = 10 sec: 705497 EffectBasePoints[0] -10001 + 1 = -10000 ms (Effect[0] aura 4 SPELL_AURA_DUMMY). AscensionWitchHunterTonicTalents.cpp:67-93 (ReduceOtherTonics) takes that amount from the other Tonic roots' remaining cooldown when a Tonic is cast. Each phase casts Pyro Tonic 802277 (RecoveryTime 120000) as the setup, waits 3100 ms for the Tonic global cooldown (category 100, as the Witch Knight entry 805346 notes), then casts Surging Tonic 802279, a different Tonic root, and reads 802277's remaining cooldown 500 ms later: the phases differ only by 705497 learned, so the after reading is the before reading less 10000 ms (expected_gain, within 100 ms, the step window of the cooldown read); the before reading must reach 100000 ms so the remaining cooldown is the fresh 120 s one.

behaviours.name: Tonic Supply (Pyro Tonic cooldown cut by Surging Tonic, gate)
behaviours.quote: Using a Tonic now reduces the cooldown of all other Tonics by $/1000;s1 sec.
behaviours.observe_source: $/1000;s1 = 10 sec: 705497 EffectBasePoints[0] -10001 + 1 = -10000 ms (Effect[0] aura 4 SPELL_AURA_DUMMY); the cut is taken from the other Tonic roots by AscensionWitchHunterTonicTalents.cpp ReduceOtherTonics when a Tonic is cast. Pyro Tonic 802277 (RecoveryTime 120000, StartRecoveryCategory 100, StartRecoveryTime 3000) is cast as the primer in each arm; Surging Tonic 802279, another Tonic root, is cast 3100 ms later (after the 3000 ms Tonic global cooldown), and Pyro Tonic is attempted so that the attempt lies 110500 ms (with and without the talent) or 109500 ms (beyond) after the primer. Without 705497 the 120000 ms cooldown runs on and the 110500 ms attempt is refused; with it the cooldown ends at 110000 ms, so the 110500 ms attempt goes through and the 109500 ms attempt is refused (SPELL_FAILED_NOT_READY). Each arm waits 3100 ms (1600 ms plus arm_wait_ms 1500) after the previous arm's attempt, so the attempt of an earlier arm cannot leave its 3000 ms Tonic global cooldown on the primer of the next (c13 diagnosis of 256.0: the beyond arm's primer was refused by that global cooldown, so its Pyro Tonic had no cooldown at all). The cut is bracketed to 9500..10500 ms: values 10% off (9000 and 11000 ms) fail one of the arms (D-200).

Before phase (control, 680538 not learned): no Lightbringer 680539 proc, the cast spends 9% of 1720 = 154.8, truncated to 154 (CalculatePct int conversion, SpellInfo.cpp:3188, Util.h:54), so 1566 is left. After phase (680538 learned): a Dusk Blade strike passes Check case 680538 (AscensionWitchHunterEvents.cpp:175-176) and, on the engine's roll of the DBC ProcChance 15 (spell_proc Chance 0), HandleProc casts Lightbringer 680539 on the caster (self(680539), Events.cpp:362-363); 680539 Effect[0] aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, EffectMiscValue[0] 14 (SPELLMOD_COST), EffectBasePoints[0] -101 + 1 = -100 percent ($680539s1 = 100) on the Purifier's Edge mask, so the next Purifier's Edge spends nothing and 1720 is left. Forcing fixture (forced_roll, ADR 0588, effect claims only): SPELLMOD_CHANCE_OF_SUCCESS +1000% on 680538 for the scenario, removed at the end and read gone; the chance itself is the 680538 proc_rate entry. Residual failure probability: the roll is forced to 11 x the 15% chance, so 165% per landed strike and the proc does not fail; the 25% chance that Purifier's Edge leaves 680539 is applied after the cost is paid (AfterCast, Abilities.cpp:418-422) and does not move the reading. behaviours.name: Witchblight (struck target misses its next swing)
behaviours.quote: Each target struck is guaranteed to miss their next instance of damage
behaviours.expected_source: Tooltip: 'guaranteed to miss' = every counted swing of an enemy carrying Witchblight 681220 is a miss (victim state 0). Each attacker carries Silithid Swarm Passive 6590 in both arms (Effect[0] aura 54 SPELL_AURA_MOD_HIT_CHANCE, EffectBasePoints 99 + DieSides 1 = +100, permanent, no proc), a named precondition fixture that brings the control miss chance to 0 under the stock 0..60% clamp of Unit::MeleeSpellMissChance, so the stated difference is the full 100 points (treatment 100%, control 0%). The aura is set on each attacker that lacks it (681220 Effect[1] aura 333, EffectBasePoints -101) every 1200 ms, below the 2000 ms swing interval of the attackers (ADR 0161), and never removed by the scenario (refresh_keeps_aura): the attacker's own swing consumes it, so each counted swing is the first after an application, and the treatment counts start after the first application. The removal of the earlier design left each attacker one 1 ms world update per cycle without the aura (one scenario step per tick), where a swing rolled at the control rate (ADR 0022). Witch Hunter ADR 0022 forces that swing's miss chance to 10001, above every urand(0, 10000) roll (the stock clamp stopped it near 60%, fix note f-n138). False pass: the nearest plausible defect, the clamped 60%, reads a difference near 60 points, far below the 95..105 band at about 180 swings per arm (probability far below 0.1% per pair); false alert: none from the roll (treatment and control both deterministic: 100% and 0%).

behaviours.name: Witchblight (a holder's next damaging spell misses and removes the aura)
behaviours.quote: Each target struck is guaranteed to miss their next instance of damage
behaviours.expected_source: Tooltip: 'guaranteed to miss their next instance of damage' (owner ruling O-39, mentor D-408/D-410/D-417, Witch Hunter ADR 0022 amendment): a holder's first damaging attempt at a target not friendly to it misses and removes the aura, so its next attempt rolls as without the aura. attacker_attempts (ADR draft, mentor D-417): 8 passive level-60 attackers (entry 36, 3 yd), the aura 681220 removed then set (stacks 1) on each before every trial of the aura arm and read back (pre), none in the two control arms (first and last, trials/4 each); per attempt the SPELL_GO count (exactly 1 or unmeasured), the damage logs at the caster (landed) and the aura on the attacker are read. Verdict: 0 landed first attempts, the aura gone after N/N of them, and the second attempts' landed share within +-5 points of the pooled control attempts (99% Newcombe interval, Wilson per arm). Spell: Shadow Bolt 25307 (Effect[0] 2 SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE, DBC), 2800 ms per attempt; 128 trials = 1024 first and 1024 second attempts, 1024 control attempts per run. Attacker hit fixture: Witch Doctor Minion Hit 803393 (Effect[1] aura 333 SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_HIT_CHANCE_ALL_PCT, EffectBasePoints 99 + DieSides 1 = +100, permanent; HandleAscensionModHitChanceAll feeds the creature's m_modSpellHitChance), set once on each attacker and read back, so Shadow Bolt's hit chance reaches the 10000 cap and the control lands near 100%. Before the fix (fu-wb2 pair 20261117-064451/-064522, worldserver 5e472b02d320) 950/960 spells missed with the aura kept 950/950. Residual (D-343, exact binomial, 512 second and 512 control attempts per run, interval rule of the verdict): with the fixture the control and the second attempts land at the same rate p; a pair false-alerts with probability 1.1e-10 at 99.8% landing, 1.3e-6 at 99.5%, 3.6e-4 at 99% and 2.8e-2 at 98%, so the entry is sized for a landing rate of 99% or more, which the pair's control arm must show. False pass: against the nearest defect, no forced miss, the first attempts land at that same rate and 0 landed of 512 has probability below (1 - p)^512, under 1e-300 at p >= 0.99 per run; a miss without consumption fails the aura read 512/512, which is deterministic. Neutral holder unmeasured (no neutral-faction fixture): the attackers are hostile, so this entry does not separate IsFriendlyTo from IsHostileTo. Fixture note (mentor D-422): 803393 is the same aura type (333) as Witchblight's own -100, so in the spell arm the two cancel and a first-attempt miss can come only from the forced miss of Witch Hunter ADR 0022.

behaviours.name: Witchblight (a holder's next special attack misses and removes the aura)

behaviours.expected_source: Tooltip: 'guaranteed to miss their next instance of damage' (owner ruling O-39, mentor D-408/D-410/D-417, Witch Hunter ADR 0022 amendment): a holder's first damaging attempt at a target not friendly to it misses and removes the aura, so its next attempt rolls as without the aura. attacker_attempts (ADR draft, mentor D-417): 8 passive level-60 attackers (entry 36, 3 yd), the aura 681220 removed then set (stacks 1) on each before every trial of the aura arm and read back (pre), none in the two control arms (first and last, trials/4 each); per attempt the SPELL_GO count (exactly 1 or unmeasured), the damage logs at the caster (landed) and the aura on the attacker are read. behaviours.name: Expert Shot (Shadowblast damage)
behaviours.quote: Increases the damage of Shadowblast by $s1%
behaviours.expected_source: $s1 = 15 (705467 EffectBasePoints[0] 14 + 1): Effect[0] aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, EffectMiscValue[0] 3, on EffectSpellClassMask[2] 16 (Shadowblast 804191, SpellFamilyFlags[2] 16). Tooltip reading: the damage of a Shadowblast hit is increased by 15%, expected mean ratio 1.15 of non-critical hits with the talent over those without (G-19 band, larger of 5% and 2 points). The Houndmaster ranged gun 3025 (27 to 51) is worn, Shadowblast costs 40 Rage (set to 400 before every cast), the dummy stands at the spell's range. Sizing: the first pair (20261115-191649 / -191740) at 1092 hits per arm read a 99% half-width of 1.5 points and the second (20261115-191914 / -192028) at 2600 per arm 1.13, both above 1 (half the 2-point band); 3640 hits per arm (52 per scenario x 70 parts) give a half-width near 0.95 points against the 1 point the judge needs (half the 2-point band); the derived margin is 3.9 sd, a residual failure probability of about 5e-5 per run and 1e-4 per pair (cycle 13 resize from 64 parts, where the derived half-width was about 1.00 point against the 1 point limit, a residual of about 48% per run, D-197). Derivation (mentor D-166): rank 1 705467 SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 scales only Shadowblast's weapon-percent effect, not its +5 fixed part, and the server rounds down (Unit.cpp:12889; SpellEffects.cpp:4681, 4740, 4743), so the delivered ratio is about 1.135 (+13.5%), inside the tooltip's 15% band 13..17; the tooltip figure stays the expectation and the rank 1 gap is an observation (c11/diag-351-204-shadowblast.md).

behaviours.name: Dark Penance rank 2 (dodge chance, Agility held)
behaviours.quote: Increases your Agility and your chance to parry and dodge by $s1%.
behaviours.observe_source: 807907 Effect[1] aura 49 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DODGE_PERCENT, EffectBasePoints[1] 3 + 1 = 4 ($s1). The caster's live dodge percentage (PLAYER_DODGE_PERCENTAGE, dodge_chance) around a Guard Strike 804432 cast before 807907 is learned (control) and after. Stoicism 804802 (Effect[0] aura 49 MOD_DODGE_PERCENT 29 + 1 = 30) is set on the caster at the start of both phases (a precondition fixture, not the claim's subject) to lift the sum clear of the floor of Player::UpdateDodgePercentage (a negative sum reads 0, review I-1 of cycle 8). The same spell's Effect[2] (aura 137 MOD_TOTAL_STAT_PERCENTAGE, Agility x1.04) adds 5 Agility (127 to 132, the Agility entry), and Agility gives dodge too: c9 read 29.6024 to 33.7477, 4.1453, the 0.1453 above 4 being that share (review I-2, never isolated). The Agility share is now held out of the contrast: in the learned phase only, Agility 8116 (Effect[0] aura 29 SPELL_AURA_MOD_STAT, MiscValue 1, EffectBasePoints 4 + 1 = 5 as in the DBC) is set on the caster with its amount changed to -4 (phase_aura_amounts, a precondition fixture, not the claim's subject): the stat is (127 - 4) x 1.04 = 127.92, read as 127, the unlearned phase's Agility, so the Agility contribution to dodge is the same in both phases and the gain is the direct term alone. The agility_held entry reads that Agility (127 before, 127 after) in the same configuration, so the cancellation is measured, not assumed. The gain must be 4 within 0.01 (G-19: a deterministic read is judged to its rounding; a direct term of 3.7 or 4.3 is refused).

behaviours.name: Slayer's Mark (melee attack power of attackers, applied swing)
behaviours.quote: Mark an enemy, increasing the attack power of all attackers against that target by 150
behaviours.expected_source: 804068 Effect[2] triggers Slayer's Mark Periodic 804073, whose aura adds 150 attack power to attackers against the target (the ap_melee and ap_ranged readbacks). Applied swings: the caster auto attacks the dummy for one main-hand swing interval (2300 ms) per trial and the plain (not critical, not glancing) main-hand hits are read, without the mark (control) and after a real cast of 804068 at the dummy before every trial (treatment, the mark lasts 8000 ms). Weapon 2027 (1H, 17.25-28.75, mean 23, speed 2300 ms, class file weapon): a white hit is the roll plus attack power / 14 x 2.3 (the scenario reads attack_power 282 here, the class file reference value, with the fixture adding 0): 23 + 46.3 = 69.3 without the mark and 23 + 432/14 x 2.3 = 94.0 with it, expected mean ratio 1.3555 (the dummy's armor multiplies both arms alike). The End Is Near 680486 (aura 72 power cost -101% on every school) is set on the caster in both arms and refreshed every trial (a harness set_aura precondition fixture, not the claim's subject): the 15% mana cost (ManaCostPercentage 15) is free, so no cast fails for lack of mana. A cast that lands while the previous mark is still up fails with SPELL_FAILED_TARGET_AURASTATE (ExcludeTargetAuraSpell 804068), and the earlier mark of at most 8000 ms still covers that swing, so every judged swing carries the mark. The earlier run read +21.3% and +22.9% because 10 of 30 casts failed for lack of mana, leaving about a third of the swings unmarked (35.55 x 20/30 = 23.7). The ranged part of the claim is not measured here. Reference search (G-11): ~/CoaServer/reference snapshots (sidekick, bindmysoul, ascension-data coabuildhub) hold only the tooltip text of 804068 and say nothing on whether the mark raises the Witch Hunter's own attack-power-scaled abilities; the fu-melee and fu-nmelee reports record no coa-history or guide-doc search for this claim, and their only recorded search (the Darkflock changelog 71840, in ~/CoaServer/reference and the guide docs) found nothing. Nothing found for the melee claim: the expectation rests on the tooltip ("all attackers") and rulings O-35 / D-403.

False alert (true cooldown 5000): impossible, the arm cannot exceed 15 events; it alerts on fewer than 1 only (1e-14). A Houndmaster's Whistle 801343 raises the Shadowhound 50124, then Houndmaster's Call 802273 (RangeIndex 36, 0 to 45 yd) sends it at the primary dummy 3 yd away; the two extra dummies stand 1.33 and 2.67 yd from the primary (primary_distance_reads, under the 5 yd), the far dummy 10 yd from it. Shadowblast 804191 is dropped (refused with 128 SPELL_FAILED_TOO_CLOSE at 3 yd in the f-m3 runs). 567570 is DmgClass 2 (SPELL_DAMAGE_CLASS_MELEE, Spell.dbc, SharedDefines.h:1666), so Unit::SpellHitResult sends it to MeleeSpellHitResult (Unit.cpp:4169-4170, 3766): a miss roll (MeleeSpellMissChance, 5% base, clamped to 0 at Unit.cpp:16888), then dodge, parry and block. Two fixture auras are set by the harness on the two extra dummies only, so an avoided swing cannot hide a missing cleave: 984584 effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_SUPPRESS_AVOIDANCE (326) at -500, at or below the -100 that turns dodge, parry and block off (Unit.cpp:3898), and 530014 effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_ATTACKER_MELEE_HIT_CHANCE (184) forced to 100 by set_aura amount, which lowers the victim miss chance by 100 and clamps it to 0; each read (aura_amount) must hold its amount on every extra dummy in both phases. The subject, the 570726 proc on each landed hound swing, is untouched. 28 landed swings per phase (58000 ms at the 2000 ms hound swing measured in f-m12). With two candidates in range the stated 1 additional enemy is judged as a count per landed hound swing (swing_cleave): a control phase without 570726, then 570726 learned; Shadow Rage 804192 is not held, so the cleave is the only source of 567570.

behaviours.name: Anguish (the Anguish aura lasts $500566d)
behaviours.quote: within $500566d
behaviours.observe_source: Anguish 500566 costs 9999 Rage and is applied only by the 504742 proc (EffectTriggerSpell[0] of 504742, self cast by the handler), so the proc is the trigger. Expected 15000 ms: Spell.dbc 500566 DurationIndex 8, SpellDuration.dbc row 8 Duration 15000 (the $500566d of the tooltip). Dusk Blade 802258 (Shadow strike and the off-hand strike 803502) is cast at the dummy 6 times 1600 ms apart with its Rage cost refilled before each; the roll of 504742 is forced by the ADR 0588 mutant (+1000% on the 5% chance, 55% per landed Shadow hit, the darkflock entries' fixture), released at the end and read gone. Every 50 ms the caster's game time, the 500566 application count (a new aura and every refresh) and its presence are read: the last application lies between the two reads where the count last rises, and the aura must be gone 15000 ms after it, the bracket inside the band (5% of 15000 = 750 ms), which excludes a duration 10% off (13500 or 16500 ms) on both sides. Control (504742 not learned): Dusk Blade strikes, no proc, no Anguish application and the aura never present. The aura is never consumed here (no Darkflock is cast), so only its own duration ends it. Residual failure probability: twelve strikes at 55% make no proc with probability 0.45^12, about 0.007% per scenario and 0.014% per pair; the false pass of a 10% neighbour duration (13500 or 16500 ms) is 0 (deterministic bracket of at most 59 ms). Reference search: the reference snapshots list Anguish 504742 without a duration, the deep-dive video shows the $d placeholder unfilled; nothing found for the value.

The class script casts 706241 on the caster for every Witchbane shot 704342 of a channel while 706240 is known (AscensionWitchHunterAbilities.cpp:148-151) and no longer removes it at a channel start or end (fix 7917649eec, mentor D-148, D-152), so the stacks carry across back-to-back casts and drop 1200 ms after the last shot. Witchbane 574320 channels 3000 ms with a 750 ms period and an extra initial period (five shots per cast). Three real Witchbane casts at the dummy (two setup casts, then the timed one, each 3300 ms apart so a shot is never more than 1200 ms old when the next cast begins) make 15 shots, more than the cap: the stack count of 706241 on the caster is read 3300 ms after the third cast began, 300 ms after its last shot, and must be 10 (the cap, not 15). behaviours.name: Arbalest Mastery (per-shot ramp)
behaviours.quote: Each subsequent shot of a Witchbane cast deals $706241s1% more damage,
behaviours.observe_source: Arbalest Mastery 706240 (server DBC set, Description[enUS]): 'Each subsequent shot of a Witchbane cast deals $706241s1% more damage, up to a maximum of ${$706241u*$706241m1}%.' 706241: EffectBasePoints[0] 14 + 1 = 15 ($706241s1, 0.15 per stack), StackAmount 10 ($706241u), DurationIndex 509 (1200 ms), Effect[0] aura 271 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_FROM_CASTER. The class script casts 706241 on the caster for every Witchbane shot 704342 of a channel while 706240 is known (AscensionWitchHunterAbilities.cpp, OnSpellCast), so shot n (from 0) of a chain carries min(n, 10) stacks: expected amount = first shot x (1 + 0.15 x min(n, 10)), 2.5 from the 11th shot on (the maximum, +150%). Witchbane 574320: Effect[0] aura 227 EffectAmplitude 750 ms, DurationIndex 27 (3000 ms), SPELL_ATTR5_EXTRA_INITIAL_PERIOD (AttributesEx5 512): 5 shots at 0, 750 ... 3000 ms. 704342: Speed 45 (389 ms travel at 17.5 yd), DmgClass 3, Effect[0] 2 SCHOOL_DAMAGE, DieSides 1 (no roll). Three casts 3750 ms apart put the 15 shots of a sequence on one 750 ms grid (each gap under the 1200 ms stack duration); four treatment sequences and one control (706240 not learned), 2500 ms apart so the stacks drop. The 706241 stacks on the caster are read after the last shot of each sequence (764 ms after it fired, inside the 1200 ms duration): 0 in the control, 10 in every treatment sequence. The _max label measures the plateau bonus (shot / first shot - 1, stated 10 x 15% = 1.5); the ratio itself is 2.5. Fixtures (preconditions, not the claim's subject): The End Is Near 680486 on the caster (Effect[0] aura 72 SPELL_AURA_MOD_POWER_COST_SCHOOL_PCT, EffectBasePoints -101, MiscValue 127: every cast free) and beeg spellpen 823764 (Effect[0] aura 123 SPELL_AURA_MOD_TARGET_RESISTANCE -10000 MiscValue 126, Effect[1] aura 108 +100 MiscValue 3); Blessed Resilience 33143 set on the dummy before every cast: its only effect is Effect[0] aura 197 SPELL_AURA_MOD_ATTACKER_SPELL_AND_WEAPON_CRIT_CHANCE, EffectBasePoints -1001 (-1000 crit chance against its bearer), target 1 (the bearer), DurationIndex 32 (6000 ms), Dispel 1; Effect[1] and Effect[2] are empty, so it adds or removes nothing besides crits taken (Unit::SpellTakenCritChance adds it for a non-positive spell; OnSpellCritChance in the class script overrides only Quickdraw with Deal with the Devil and Shadow Rage). The reads take only non-critical, unblocked shots, so the fixture lowers exclusions and never decides an amount. Misses, dodges and parries are removed by the class file ratings (ranged hit, melee hit and expertise 10000). Residual (D-197, D-198): the only exclusion left is a block (Unit::GetUnitBlockChance gives a creature 5%, upper bound); a stack count goes uncovered only if its shot is excluded in all four sequences, 0.05^4 = 6.25e-6, over 11 counts about 6.9e-5 per run and 1.4e-4 per pair (unmeasured, never ok). Deterministic amounts: false pass at the control (flat) or the neighbouring 10% per stack is refused by the rounding band (1 + the multiplier points, holding a rounded or floored amount) while the first shot exceeds 86 points, which the judge checks.

behaviours.quote: You may now cast Darkslayer while moving.
behaviours.observe_source: Spell::prepare (Spell.cpp:3645-3657) refuses a player cast with a cast time and SPELL_INTERRUPT_FLAG_MOVEMENT while the caster moves, with SPELL_FAILED_MOVING (51), unless Unit::CanCastSpellWhileMoving (Unit.cpp:4992-5026) finds an aura 313 whose class mask selects the spell; Spell::update cancels such a cast if the caster moves during it (Spell.cpp:4519-4530, SPELL_FAILED_INTERRUPTED 40). Darkslayer 681203 (the level 60 rank) has CastingTimeIndex 19 (2500 ms) and InterruptFlags 3. 92091 casts 500570 on the caster while held (AscensionWitchHunterDefenses.cpp:204-205), an aura 313 (SpellFamilyName 21, EffectSpellClassMask word 2 = 32, the Darkslayer family flag). The caster holds the forward movement flag (moving_before_trigger) from right before each Darkslayer until the reading 3000 ms later, past the 2500 ms cast. Before (control, no 92091): refused with 51. After (92091 learned): 0, neither refused nor interrupted while moving.

behaviours.name: Blade of the Misbegotten (maximum health of the last three Dawn Blade hits)
behaviours.quote: increases your health by 15% of the damage dealt
behaviours.observe_source: The ring_sum entry of 680530 read on the caster's maximum health instead of the 524669 aura amount (ring_sum read max_health, ADR 0732). Learned contrast: each phase casts Dawn Blade 802024 four times at the dummy, 1600 ms apart (its 1500 ms global cooldown); the talent 680530 is learned between the phases. Each direct Dawn Blade hit (AscensionWitchHunterEvents.cpp:168-170) writes damage x 15 / 100 (integer) into a three-slot ring and recasts 524669 (Effect[0] aura 34 SPELL_AURA_MOD_INCREASE_HEALTH, a flat maximum health increase) with SPELLVALUE_BASE_POINT0 = the sum of the ring (AscensionWitchHunterEvents.cpp:343-354); the server keeps StackAmount 1 (AscensionWitchHunterCompletion.cpp:254-258), so the three stacks are the three slots. The caster's maximum health after the fourth hit, less its maximum health at the end of the control phase (no talent, no 524669), must equal the sum of the last three shares exactly and differ from the sum of all four. Crit fixture 984954 (spell crit -1000 from its Effect[1]; its Effect[0] weapon crit +101 is reset to -1000 by phase_aura_amounts, so weapon crit is removed too) and Beeg spellpen 823764 are precondition fixtures.

behaviours.name: Secret of Raven Hill (Surging Blade weapon damage)
behaviours.quote: Drinking a Tonic will transform your Dawn Blade into powerful damaging spells with unique effects for $681499d based on the last Tonic consumed.
behaviours.observe_source: Design D-16 (weapon-percent-only script hit, weapon_only). The talent 680513 (learned in the treatment arm) lets the transformation exist: drinking a Tonic casts Secret of Raven Hill's window aura 681499 and swaps Dawn Blade for the child spell of that Tonic (AscensionWitchHunterAbilities.cpp:495-499; Surging Tonic 802279 gives Surging Blade 681788); the child spell is refused without 680513 and 681499 (:241-243, SPELL_FAILED_CASTER_AURASTATE 22). Surging Blade 681788 (server DBC set): Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_WEAPON_PERCENT_DAMAGE, EffectBasePoints 279 + 1 = 280% ($s1), no school damage effect, DmgClass 2 melee, Physical, EquippedItemSubClassMask 1378 (two-handed weapons; the entry wears the Black Knight two-handed weapon set). Each trial: a real Surging Tonic at the caster, then Surging Blade at the dummy. Control arm: 680513 not known, every Surging Blade refused (no hit). Treatment: the mean non-critical 681788 hit against 280% of the weapon roll plus the attack power bonus, armor-mitigated (the measured stats and dummy armor). Critical hits are excluded by the read; no crit fixture: 984954 raises weapon crit by 101% (its Effect[0] aura 52), so a weapon hit would always crit under it (pilot 20261116-065338: 30 of 30 critical). Precondition proof of the directly cast replacement 681788: the entry '680513 behaviour_metric_delta last_surging' reads Dawn Blade 802024 replaced by 681788 after the matching real Tonic is the last one consumed.

behaviours.name: Tormenting the Tormented (Tormentor ticks crit under a forced ranged crit)

behaviours.observe_source: 805758 Effect[0] aura 286 SPELL_AURA_ABILITY_PERIODIC_CRIT on EffectSpellClassMask word 2 = 268435456, the SpellFamilyFlags[2] of Tormentor 800162 (SpellFamilyName 21). The caster's ranged crit is forced (force_crit ranged, harness rating fixture), so every hit that may crit does: the critical damage count of 800162 on the dummy after one cast and 14500 ms is the direct hit alone without 805758 (1, control) and the direct hit plus the 7 ticks with it learned (cumulative 1 + 8 = 9). behaviours.name: Unbroken (additional attack power on swings against Demons and Undead)
behaviours.quote: Increased further against Demons and Undead.

versus_creature_type.source: acore_world creature_template read 2026-11-16: 36 Harvest Golem type 9 (Mechanical) and 6133 Shade of Elura type 6 (Undead), both minlevel 11 (the dummies' armor comes from that level, min_level_armor), unit_class 1, ArmorModifier 1, rank 0, no creature_template_resistance row, no AIName or ScriptName, immunities -93 / -113 (mechanics only, SchoolMask 0); 418 Lesser Voidwalker type 3 (Demon), the striker

behaviours.expected_source: Claim 296.2 part B2 (owner ruling O-28, mentor D-250/D-251 T10): "that additional attack power added to the player's hits against Demons and Undead". 707487 Effect[1] aura 102 SPELL_AURA_MOD_MELEE_ATTACK_POWER_VERSUS, EffectMiscValue 36 (types 3 Demon and 6 Undead, 1 << (type - 1)), Spell.dbc; its amount is the live versus share that 707407 behaviour_metric_delta versus_amount counts. The stock melee rule adds int(amount / 14 x weapon speed) to a swing against a creature whose type is in the mask (Unit::MeleeDamageBonusDone, Unit.cpp:11435 and :11447); the weapon is the class file's main hand 2027 (2300 ms). Both arms after the same strikes from the Demon striker (32247, 1000 Physical): the store fills to its cap and each trial's strike refills it, the attack power and the 707487 Effect[1] amount are read before each swing, and the plain (not critical, not glancing) main-hand hits are read against the Mechanical dummy (control) and the otherwise identical Undead dummy (treatment); the dummies' armor, level and magic resistances are read and must be equal. The judged difference is the modelled int(amount / 14 x 2.3) per hit reduced by the read armor, with both arms shifted to their common mean attack power. Sizing (D-264, D-266; review c15 I-4): the judge sizes to 0.8 of half the band (bonus.py SIZING_SHARE_OF_POWER), 3.62 points of the 4.52 half band. The 140-swing pair (runs 120421 parts 1 and 2) read half-widths 4.50 and 4.53 on 146 and 142 plain hits per arm (133 control in the second run); 142 x (4.53 / 3.62)^2 = 222 plain hits per arm, and the 60-swing diagnostic (20261116-111946, half-width 6.44) gives 190. One scenario holds 84 swings, so 4 pooled parts of 70 swings (280 per arm, at least 266 plain hits at the lowest plain share seen, 133 of 140), which puts the half-width near 3.3. Residual (D-250, D-261): the judge alerts when the reading lies outside the band or the whole 99% interval does, and judges only a half-width at most 4.52. At the largest judged half-width 3.62 the standard error is 1.405 points, so a server at the modelled difference alerts only on a reading 9.04 points off, 6.4 standard errors, probability 1.3e-10 per run and 2.6e-10 per pair, at most 0.1%; the pair holds band + 2 x half-width = 16.3 points. False pass: a server adding no versus attack power (difference 0) or half of it (90) lies 122 or 58 standard errors outside the band, probability about 0. A server reading short of the model by the 3.6% seen (about 6.5 points) lies 2.5 points inside the band, 1.8 standard errors, so the lead is reported with the measured ratio and interval, not changed in the model

behaviours.expected_source: Tooltip: 'guaranteed to critically strike' = a 100% critical share of Quickdraw 806851 with Deal With The Devil 680255 known. behaviours.name: Twilight Frenzy (dodge while channeling)
behaviours.quote: Can dodge and parry and move while active.
behaviours.expected_source: Tooltip 805751: 'Can dodge and parry and move while active.' Twilight Frenzy is a self channel (AttributesEx 268436544 has SPELL_ATTR1_IS_SELF_CHANNELLED 64, DurationIndex 28 = 5000 ms, Effect[2] aura 23 periodic trigger 805752); the server removes its SPELL_ATTR5_ALLOW_ACTION_DURING_CHANNEL (AscensionWitchHunterCompletion.cpp:183-184). The engine zeroes a melee swing's dodge and parry while the victim casts or channels (Unit::RollMeleeOutcomeAgainst, Unit.cpp:3413-3416 and 3446-3449) unless Unit::CanDefendDuringChannel or CanDefendDuringCast allow it (Unit.cpp:5077-5098: a Witch Hunter channelling Twilight Frenzy 805751 (Witch Hunter ADR 0015, owner O-31), a Demon Hunter channelling 800206, or an aura 348 SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_DEFEND_DURING_CAST against a creature). Precondition fixture of both arms, named: the caster's dodge chance forced to 100% and the other to 0% (set_combat_avoidance, ADR 0735's step) at every cycle. Control: Witchbane 574320, a Witch Hunter channel at the dummy 17.5 yd away (Witchbane fails with SPELL_FAILED_TOO_CLOSE 128 at an attacker 3 yd away, pilot 20261116-105437; AttributesEx 4 SPELL_ATTR1_IS_CHANNELLED, AttributesEx5 512 without ALLOW_ACTION_DURING_CHANNEL, DurationIndex 27 = 3000 ms, ChannelInterruptFlags 0 so no pushback, ManaCost 400 = 40 Rage set before each cast, RangeIndex 114 0-35 yd, recast every 2000 ms, its channel lasting 3000 ms in diagnostic 20261116-105821), an ordinary channel: expected 0 dodges. Treatment: a real Twilight Frenzy cast on the caster every 600 ms (ManaCost 100 set before each cast, StartRecoveryTime 0; its channel and aura end between 800 and 1000 ms after the cast in diagnostic 20261116-105728, with or without attackers, against DurationIndex 28 = 5000 ms: an observation, not changed): if the clause holds, the dodges share is the swings that do not miss. The casting read at each cycle end must be 1 (the channel covers every counted swing). Judge above_control (ADR 0761): the 99% Newcombe difference interval of the dodges shares at or above 2 points passes (G-19's 2-point minimum, no rate stated), below 2 points alerts. 150000 ms per arm with 8 attackers; a 0-of-n control share has a 99% Wilson upper bound under 2% from 326 swings, so a blocked treatment (exactly 0, deterministic) alerts and an allowed one (near the hit share) passes; residual failure probability below 0.1% per pair once each arm holds 326 swings (both arms deterministic at 0 under a blocking channel; a passing share must fall below about 3% to fail).

behaviours.quote: and your Armor penetration by $s2%.
behaviours.expected_source: $s2 = 10 (520548 EffectBasePoints[1] 9 + 1): Effect[1] aura 280 SPELL_AURA_MOD_ARMOR_PENETRATION_PCT, EffectMiscValue 0, EquippedItemClass -1, affecting every spell of the player. Burrow Bolt 802269 (Effect[0] SCHOOL_DAMAGE, DieSides 1, a flat Physical hit, SchoolMask 1) is cast at the dummy with Lesser Armor 673 amount 10000 on the dummy in both arms (target_aura_amounts, a precondition fixture, not the claim's subject): the control arm without 520548, the treatment arm with it learned. The engine's stock rule (Unit.cpp:2509-2557, no CoA code): the sum of aura 280 is capped, maxArmorPen = min((armor + C) / 3, armor) with C = 85 x victim level + 400 = 5500 at level 60, and the armor removed is 10% of that cap, not 10% of the armor (a stock-engine rule, not the tooltip's plain reading); the hit is reduced by r / (1 + r), r = armor / C, ceil. Armor 10528 (528 reference + 10000, read at the end of each arm: '... control target armor' / '... treatment target armor'): base 5106 (6 + 2 x 50 at level 60, plus 0.25 x attack power 20000) gives 1753 without and 1813 with the talent, ratio 1.0342 (+3.42%, band 2 points: 1.42 to 5.42). The uncapped reading (10% of the full armor) would give +7.02% and a missing aura 0%, both outside the band. The dummy level and the armor read in the run replace these figures if they differ. Burrow Bolt has no ignore-armor attribute. The End Is Near 680486 is set in both arms (precondition fixture).

behaviours.name: Tormentor (one non-critical direct hit at +20000 spell power)
behaviours.observe_source: DBC 501349 (Tormentor, Rank 7, SpellLevel 60, DmgClass 3 ranged, SchoolMask 32, SpellFamilyName 21): Effect[2] 2 SCHOOL_DAMAGE, EffectBasePoints[2] 60, EffectDieSides[2] 12, so $m3 rolls 61..72 (mean 66.5); Effect[0] 6 aura 3 PERIODIC_DAMAGE, EffectBasePoints[0] 87, EffectDieSides[0] 2, EffectRealPointsPerLevel[0] 1.598 x (60 - BaseLevel 60) = 0, so $m1 rolls 88..89 once per aura; EffectAmplitude[0] 2000 ms over DurationIndex 305 = 14000 ms, so $d*1000/$T1 = 7 ticks. The crossbow 15809 is worn (spell_weapon_sets, server_inventory_masks ADR 0890); the dummy stands 17.5 yd away (the hit scenario's midpoint of the ranged range; at 3 yd the cast fails with SPELL_FAILED_TOO_CLOSE 128, run 20261116-182219); beeg spellpen 823764 removes the dummy's resistance in both phases; before = no cast, 0. Direct hit only (periodic false, the SMSG_SPELLNONMELEEDAMAGELOG event): at 20000 spell power (player_spell_power hit_arm; $sps and $sph are both 20000, so either branch reads $m3 + 3500), only non-critical events count (critical false), so no crit multiplier enters: 61..72 + 3500 = 3561..3572, mean 3566.5; band 5% (G-19). Neighbouring coefficients .15 (3061..3072) and .2 (4061..4072) fall outside; without the spell power term 61..72. Contrast arm: 501349 hit_mean at the reference spell power 0. Crit removal (review9 I-2): the fixture aura 984954 (Reg's Test Aura, Effect[0] aura 52 MOD_CRIT_PERCENT, Effect[1] aura 57 MOD_SPELL_CRIT_CHANCE) is held on the caster in both phases with its Effect[0] amount set to -100 (phase_aura_amounts), so the flat ranged crit modifier is -100 and Player::UpdateCritPercentage clamps PLAYER_RANGED_CRIT_PERCENTAGE at 0 (StatSystem.cpp:847); Tormentor is DmgClass 3 (ranged), whose caster crit chance is that field (Unit.cpp:10285-10288). Effect[0]'s default +101 weapon crit is not used. A scratch probe of this scenario (not counted, run 20261116-192902) read ranged_taken_crit_chance on the dummy at 0 and 0 critical 501349 direct hits, one cast reading 3569. Residual failure probability for a crit: 0, the chance being clamped at 0 (a miss is the only other way to read 0).

behaviours.quote: Strike an enemy, dealing $s2% Weapon Damage plus ${$m1+0}, scaling with your parry rating, and healing you for ${$574336m1}% of the damage dealt.
behaviours.observe_source: Noctis Blade 680615 (SchoolMask 32 Shadow, DmgClass 2 melee, SpellLevel 56, ManaCostPercentage 7: 120 mana set before the cast; EquippedItemSubClassMask 1378: the Black Knight set's two-handed 2529 Zweihander, 73.62 to 103.34, normalized speed 3.3, the entry's spell weapon set). Effect[0] SCHOOL_DAMAGE EffectBasePoints 252 + irand(1, 25) = 253 to 277 ($m1 = 253; the tooltip's '${$m1+0}' has no per-level term, so no level scaling is added), Effect[1] WEAPON_PERCENT_DAMAGE 99 + 1 = 100 ($s2), Effect[2] NORMALIZED_WEAPON_DMG, spell_bonus_data 680615 all zero. Reference attack power 282 (class file reference_stats), so the normalized weapon term is 282 / 14 x 3.3 = 66.47. No hit is avoided (class ratings: melee hit and expertise 10000) and no hit is critical: Thundering Strikes 16255 (Effect[0] aura 290 SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT, harness set_aura, a precondition fixture) is set on the caster with its effect-0 amount -100, and beeg spellpen 823764 (precondition fixture) removes partial resists of the Shadow hit. Expected from the DBC and the item alone: 253 + 73.62 + 66.47 = 393.1 at the lowest rolls, 277 + 103.34 + 66.47 = 446.8 at the highest, judged in [392, 448] (one point of truncation slack on each end). A weapon percent of 50 instead of 100 would read 323 to 362, no weapon term 253 to 277, no flat term 140 to 170: all outside the window. Deterministic read of one hit (no probabilistic outcome: crit 0, no avoidance), false-pass and false-alert probability 0 per pair. No hit without the cast (control, before reading 0).

behaviours.observe_source: Claim 224.0 of 681453 ("While you remain near it, hostile spells targeting you are deflected."), Pavise 520865 taught by 681453 (@s:520865). 520865 Effect[0] summons 50519 (Effect[1] zeroed, AscensionWitchHunterCompletion.cpp:397-398); the summon casts 1108180 Pavise Effect on itself (AscensionWitchHunterSummons.cpp:353-357): Effect[0] 143 SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_OWNER, aura 287 SPELL_AURA_DEFLECT_SPELLS, EffectBasePoints[0] 99 + 1 = 100, EffectRadiusIndex[0] 16 (SpellRadius 16 = 1 yd), Spell.dbc read with apps/coa-dbc/inspect_dbc.py. The engine adds that aura's 100 x 100 to the magic hit roll as SPELL_MISS_DEFLECT only when the caster is in the victim's front 180 degrees and the victim is not stunned (Unit::MagicSpellHitResult, Unit.cpp:4087-4094); from behind, the Witch Hunter hook rolls the same 1108180 amount once for the same spell set (owner ruling O-47, Witch Hunter ADR 0026). The striker (the harness strike, creature 36, the class level, spell_hit_bonus 100, 3 yd along +x) casts Arcane Blast 16067 (Effect[0] SCHOOL_DAMAGE only, DmgClass magic, no mechanic, no aura) at the caster, harness-triggered: the hit roll is capped at 100%, no miss and no resist term, so a strike lands unless deflected; the deflect roll leaves 1 in 10000 (irand(1, 10000) < 10000). Arms (deflect_arcs): control, before any Pavise cast, striker in front: 20 strikes must all land; front, 1500 ms after the real Pavise cast at the caster, 1108180 read on the caster: 20 strikes, at most 1 may land (judged: the gain of landed strikes over the control is 0 within 1); outside, the caster moved 8 yd to the side (the striker still in front, read from the positions and the caster's orientation), 1108180 read 0, the Pavise 50519 still present (owned_creature_count 50519 read on the caster in this arm: it must read 1, a 0 or a missing read alerts): all 20 land; behind, the caster moved to stand 3 yd past the striker (the striker behind it, read from the positions and the caster's orientation), Pavise cast again there, 1108180 read: 20 strikes, at most 1 may land (judged, owner ruling O-47 on card Q-wh-45: every direction). Sizing: a strike lands through the aura with probability 1e-4, so 2 or more of 20 land with probability 1.9e-6 per arm and run, 7.6e-6 per pair over the front and behind arms (false alert); a server deflecting 50% passes an arm with at most 1 of 20 landed with probability 21 / 2^20 = 2.0e-5 per run, 4e-10 per pair (false pass). Proven: hostile spells cast at the caster from the front and from behind while it stands near the Pavise do not land, and do land with the caster out of the radius; the miss type DEFLECT is the data arm pavise_deflect_rolls (READBACK). Reference search (nf-i, 2026-11-17): coa-history spell 1108180, 520865 and 681453 reads 0 events in 186 logs (every source and event type; no positive control run for it); ~/CoaServer/reference snapshots (bindmysoul, sidekick, ascension-data) carry only the tooltip text of Pavise Crossbowman 681453, nothing found on an arc, front, behind or near-distance reading.

behaviours.observe_source: Claim 362.2 of Decimate 804194 ("and allowing them to ignore Armor."): Effect[1] 190 SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_APPLY_AURA_TO_SUMMONS with aura 280 SPELL_AURA_MOD_ARMOR_PENETRATION_PCT, EffectBasePoints[1] 99 + 1 = 100 (Spell.dbc read with apps/coa-dbc/inspect_dbc.py), rewritten by the server to SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_IGNORE_ARMOR_PCT (AscensionWitchHunterCompletion.cpp:236-237), which Unit::CalcArmorReducedDamage sums on the attacker (Unit.cpp:2452-2466). The Houndmaster's Call strike 706332 is Shadow and armor never reduces non-physical damage (Unit::IsDamageReducedByArmor, Unit.cpp:2400-2404), so the claim is read on the Shadowhound pet's physical white swings (D-462). The Shadowhound 50124 is the current pet (Houndmaster's Whistle 801343 Effect[0] 56 SUMMON_PET); its plain swings are read by its pet GUID (pet_melee_plain_damage and _count with no entry, which avoids the entry match that never selects a Pet). Two dummies of the same fixture: the dummy holds Harden Skin 22693 (aura 22 SPELL_AURA_MOD_RESISTANCE, EffectMiscValue 1 armor, EffectBasePoints 9999 + 1 = +10000) as a precondition fixture so that its armor reduces a swing by far more than the band (pilot 20261117-150317 without it: armor 528, factor 0.913, too close to 1), the bare dummy holds Dematerialize Armor 40935 (aura 101 SPELL_AURA_MOD_RESISTANCE_PCT, EffectMiscValue 1 armor, EffectBasePoints -101 + 1 = -100) as a precondition fixture, armor read 0. Decimate's +30% damage and haste act on both dummies alike and cancel in the per-hit ratio. Expected with Decimate: ratio 1.0 (100% of the armor ignored); contrast without it: the ratio equals the pet's armor_reduced_damage against the dummy read per 1000 (READBACK data arm, the engine's armor factor at the read armor and levels); both within 5% of the ratio (G-19), 99% interval rules of the hit ratio judge. Decimate is recast before every window (cooldown reset, mana set to 2400) and read on the pet at the end of each with-arm. Both fixtures are removed and set again before every window (a set_aura on a held aura keeps its running duration; Harden Skin lasts 10 s and Dematerialize Armor 8 s, so run 20261117-150521 met an armor that lapsed: contrast 0.44 against the read 0.344), and both dummies' armor is read at every window end and must equal the first reads. Sizing (D-261): the pilot's 20 windows of 4000 ms per arm gave a 99% half-width of 2.84 points against a power limit of 2.5 (half the band), trials_needed 26; 40 windows put it near 2.0, but the end pair read a 99% half-width of 4.39 and 4.17 points at 40 windows (trials_needed 124 and 112), so the entry runs 200 windows per arm: the focused pair 20261117-180011 and 20261117-180138 read 0.78 and 0.79 points. Residual: a server at the model alerts only when the whole 99% interval leaves the 5-point band, about 7 points or 9 standard errors off, probability below 1e-12 per run; false pass: a server ignoring no armor reads the contrast ratio (about 0.34 at 10528 armor) and one ignoring half of it about 0.5, both tens of standard errors outside the band. Reference search (nf-i, 2026-11-17): coa-history spell 804194 reads 0 events in 186 logs (every source and event type; no positive control run for it); ~/CoaServer/reference snapshots (bindmysoul, sidekick, ascension-data) carry only the tooltip text of Decimate 804194, nothing found on armor ignored by the hounds beyond the tooltip words.

Option rage_per_damage (ADR 1004 provisional, mentor D-465): one real bolt per phase at the dummy 17.5 yd away, Rage set to 0 at the start of both phases with regeneration and decay off; the before phase at the reference ranged attack power, the after phase with QA Test +1000 Melee and Ranged AP 10031 (the 807284 rap hit_ratio entry reads that contrast as +92% damage); Reduce Critical Strike Chance -100% 64481 in both phases, and a critical hit makes the phase unmeasured. The per-hit truncation moves the ratio by at most 1/170 + 1/340 raw (about 0.9%), so the read is deterministic inside the band: false alert 0. A Rage independent of the damage reads 1 / contrast <= 0.667 and alerts in every run (false pass 0); a fixed Rage per hit added to a proportional part passes while its share of the before phase's Rage stays up to 10% at contrast 2 and 15% at contrast 1.5 (about 10.5% at the counted contrast of about 1.9; ADR 1004). behaviours.observe_source: 573266 DurationIndex 28 (5000 ms, $573266d), Effect[0] aura 138 MOD_MELEE_HASTE 15% on the owner's Shadowhound 50124 (705531 proc on a ranged auto attack crit, AscensionWitchHunterEvents.cpp:151-152, :300-304; the hound_haste entry reads 1739.13 ms = 2000 / 1.15). 705531 is learned from the start; the before phase summons the hound with Houndmaster's Whistle 801343 and casts no Auto Shot (2000 ms). The treatment summons it again and casts Auto Shot 75 at the dummy 8 yd away (Speed 40 yd/s, about 200 ms of flight), every ranged hit a crit (ranged_crit_rating fixture). Option stop_shooting_after_ms (ADR 1005 provisional, mentor D-468): 300 ms after the cast the caster moves 40 yd back along x (two relocate steps of 20 yd), 48 yd from the dummy, beyond Auto Shot's 35 yd (SpellRange 114), so _UpdateAutoRepeatSpell's CheckCast fails and no shot fires (Unit.cpp:4740-4751; stop_attack cannot stop it, Unit.cpp:8357); the hit count of 75 must read at least 1 before the move and the same at both later readings, and the move must come at most 325 ms after the cast, so the aura began 0..325 ms after it. Game-time windows from the cast: the after reading at 4825..4975 ms must still read 1739.13 (the aura lasted at least 4825 - 325 = 4500 ms), the expired reading at 5375..5495 ms must read 2000 (it lasted less than 5495 ms): a duration 10% off (4500 or 5500 ms) fails one of them (D-200). The stated 5000 ms passes both with 50 ms or more to spare for an aura start anywhere in 0..325 ms. The expired window top is 5495 ms, not 5475 (ADR 1008 provisional, review C-1 follow-up): the measured expired reading at 5461 ms keeps 34 ms, more than one 25 ms step, and the top stays under 5500 ms, so a 5500 ms aura started at 0 ms or later is still present at any accepted reading. Deterministic reads to the 25 ms step: false alert and false pass 0 given the fixture holds (a failed fixture is unmeasured). Bound (review-h I-1): the cast stamp is taken two harness ticks before the read (behaviours.py:1752-1754, about 6 ms, more than the 5 ms spare under 5500 ms), so the window top alone does not fail a 5500 ms aura; it fails because the Auto Shot hit lands at least 125 ms after the cast (projectile flight, Spell.cpp:2474-2476, DBC Speed 40), so the aura cannot start before that and a 5500 ms aura is still present at any expired reading under 5495 ms.

arms.source: Friendly bystander (entry 68, FACTION_FRIENDLY 35) keeps REP_FRIENDLY (4) under Infiltrate 802281 per settled IfNormalReaction fix (AscensionWitchHunterDefenses.cpp:430-443).

cast_auras.reason: Fiery Judgement 803369 costs 11% of base mana (ManaCostPercentage 11); the base hit scenario failed 878 casts with SPELL_FAILED_NO_POWER (85) and kept 66 usable hits (base pair 20261114-195329/-195535). The End Is Near 680486 (aura 72 SPELL_AURA_MOD_POWER_COST_SCHOOL_PCT -101 on every school, no damage effect) makes every cast free: a precondition fixture, the claim is the damage.

Darkslayer's Lantern 802139 costs mana (ManaCostPercentage in Spell.dbc); the base hit scenario kept too few usable hits without a free cast. The End Is Near 680486 (aura 72 SPELL_AURA_MOD_POWER_COST_SCHOOL_PCT -101 on every school, no damage effect) makes every cast free: a precondition fixture, the claim is the damage.

At the hit_location start the caster is under water: without a breathing aura it took drowning damage from about 180 s on (health 2236 -> 1760 -> 783 -> 0 between casts 86 and 89, diagnostic 20261116-185240). Water Breathing 7178 (aura 82 SPELL_AURA_WATER_BREATHING only, no damage effect) is set on the caster before each cast: a precondition fixture, the claim is the damage.

Darkslayer R9 681203 costs 8% of base mana (ManaCostPercentage 8 = 137 mana/cast) across 300 hit_parts casts; The End Is Near 680486 (aura 72 SPELL_AURA_MOD_POWER_COST_SCHOOL_PCT -101 on every school, no damage effect) makes every cast free, matching existing Witch Hunter 803369 and 802139 entries.

value_links.arithmetic: the flat 45 of ${45+$807527ppl2+$RAP*0.25} has no Spell.dbc effect behind it (mentor D-154 literal), so the effect_value read stays unmodelled; the rap hit_ratio entry builds its expected ratio from the whole card formula, per shot 39 + 0.2 x RAP + 45 + int32(49 x 1.8 = 88.2) + int32(0.25 x RAP) = 278.4 at the reference ranged attack power 237 and 728.4 at 1237, ratio 2.616 (without the 45 the ratio would be 2.93, outside the 8.1 point band), so a passing read proves the 45 together with the per-level and RAP parts

807284.reason: Heartseeking Bolt 807284 shows its weapon part as a literal: the streamed coa_client_spell_description row of rev_20261115_02_witch_hunter_heartseeking_bolt_text.sql (owner ruling O-15, line 8) reads 'deals 300% Ranged Weapon Damage plus ${$m1+244+0+$RAP*0.5+$sps*0.3}', with no $s2 token, so the 300% is taken from that text row (mentor D-252/D-253), not from Spell.dbc Effect[1] (BasePoints 199 + DieSides 1 = 200%).
